svg.title: All XMAS words in the 10 by 10 example
svg.desc: Each gold line is one XMAS found in the example grid, in any of the 8 directions, 18 in total. The Go code checks XMAS and SAMX from each cell and uses a cache of cell paths so that each line of 4 cells is checked once.

g.text: Part 1 · lines of four cells in eight directions
blue: letters used by some XMAS · gold: one line per word found
18 words · circle = the X where a word starts
from every cell, look in 8 directions
count it if they spell XMAS
the same 4 cells are reached twice:
so findWord stores the cell path "0x0|1x0|2x0|3x0" and
its reverse in a cache and skips paths already checked
